sources.use: Mask reuse/Counter mode and reduction API tradeoffs; tested mask-only candidates, modest effect.
SetL2CacheHint semantics; tested input+output bypass and output-only bypass.
DMA block size, 512-byte alignment; corrected local runner guard alignment for both baseline and candidate.
Official rotate-half operator equation and supported hardware; interface has cos/sin input, so cannot substitute directly for this contest ABI.
Head tiling, shared per-token cos/sin, UB footprint accounting. No external code copied.
Token/head partitioning and fused rotary writes; its external cos/sin cache is outside the contest interface.
Available PMU/L2 metrics; non-replay L2 counters added to avoid replay cache-state effects.

local_sdk_checks: CANN 9.0.0 MulCast on dav_c220 supports half to int8/uint8, not a float/half multiply-cast fast path.
Copy emits vcopy; DataCopy UB-to-UB emits copy_ubuf_to_ubuf. Regular vector-copy candidate measured slower.
Float sin/cos and frequencies stay FP32; FP16 coefficient conversion occurs only for permitted FP16 rotation.
